Morning light on water
item.description:
The way the early sun hits the river at a low angle — it doesn’t just reflect, it seems to travel through the surface. Each ripple carries the light differently. The far bank was barely visible through the mist, and the water was the brightest thing in sight.

Noticed: how the eye naturally tracks the brightest point in a scene, even when it’s moving.

item.title: The Physics of our Voice: Part 1
Why does music give us goosebumps?
item.description:
Some chord progressions, a certain voice, or a particular moment in a song creates a physical sensation — chills, shivers, goosebumps. This is called “frisson.” It happens to about 55–86% of people, and not equally.

What I’ve read so far:

  • It seems connected to dopamine release. PET and fMRI studies show activation in the caudate and nucleus accumbens — the same reward pathways triggered by food or money.
  • Musical “violations of expectation” seem to be key. The chills often come when a chord doesn’t resolve the way you expected, or when a new instrument enters unexpectedly.
  • People who are more “open to experience” (a Big Five personality trait) seem to experience frisson more frequently.

item.title: Gauss's sum — the trick that changes how you see arithmetic
item.description:
Problem: Find the sum of the first $n$ natural numbers: $1 + 2 + 3 + \cdots + n$.

Solution:

Write the sum twice — once forwards, once backwards, and add column by column:

$$S = 1 + 2 + 3 + \cdots + n$$ $$S = n + (n-1) + (n-2) + \cdots + 1$$ $$2S = (n+1) + (n+1) + \cdots + (n+1) \quad (n \text{ times})$$

Let the Crypto begin
item.description:
Hey there, Link to heading

Finally, the semester is over, and here I am motivated to start something. What can be a better way than a blog post. This post is somewhat about my dive into the world of blockchains and cryptocurrency but more so about why we need a community here at IIT Kanpur to make people familiar with it. At the very least, there could be more awareness among the IITK community about this new technology that is changing everything around us.
